correctness.rationale: The forward shift on c0 satisfies (W_c x)_n=sum_{j<n} c_j x_{n-j}; the n-th row has norm sum_{j<n}|c_j| and rows approach ||c||_1, establishing ||W_c||=||c||_1. The positive l1 functional has norm A but is nowhere norm-attained on B_c0 since a_n>0 for all n. With C<A, scalar norming is forced: f_a(x^k)->lambda A implies, via the nonnegative series a_n(1-Re(conj(lambda)x_n^k)), each fixed x_n^k->lambda; thus any norm limit of W_c x^k has coordinates lambda b_n. Since the actual image limit lies in c0 and b_n->s(c), necessity s(c)=0 follows. For s(c)=0, finite ramps have the uniform estimate ||W_cu^k-b||_infty <= sup_{n>k}|b_n|+sum_j|c_j|min(1,j/k)->0; this proves sufficiency and exactly the circle of norm-A limits. If c has infinite support, every row of a norm limit has modulus strictly less than C, which excludes a norm-C point of c0; finite support allows one saturating row. The coefficient map c->T_c is an isometry for differences; ||c-d||_1>=|s(c)|, with equality attained inside ||d||_1<A by the displayed complex-phase, positive-projection correction. The cases c=0 and real/complex phases, quantifiers and the strict gap were checked. Independent exact rational distance and finite ramp tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The graph T_c=(f_a,W_c) couples a natural positive l1 functional on c0 to a Wiener algebra (absolutely summable forward-shift) convolution, with the natural symbol evaluation s(c)=p(1). Its QNA membership is a complete nontrivial infinite-dimensional classification by that one frequency, distinct from the finite-support QNA/NA criterion for W_c alone. The exact attained operator-norm distance |s(c)| gives a quantitative and geometrically transparent codimension-one boundary, and explicit examples show that quasi norm attainment is not a naive coordinatewise property under a max-sum target. This is a motivated analytic family and exact invariant, not a finite experiment, parameter renaming or a global density claim.
